A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''shaper''' with a lisp was on [[Coruscant/Legends|Yuuzhan'tar]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. At one [[Time/Legends|time]], he was approached by [[Nom Anor|Hooley Krekk]], who wished to know what the shaping cortexs were. The shaper filled Krekk in, unknowingly giving Nom Anor, who was posing as Krekk, the last bits of evidence to prove that the [[eighth cortex]] was fake.
